tagline: Market leader in outsourced maritime health and wellness services, helping guests look and feel their best.
hero_kpi_rationale: OneSpaWorld is the undisputed global leader in the maritime health and wellness services sector, with an estimated market share of over 90%. This dominant position and the revenue generated represent the fundamental KPI reflecting the company's operational performance.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total revenue generated from operating activities.
kpis.description: Total revenue reflects the company's overall performance in its maritime and destination spa health and wellness operations.
kpis.signal: Primary indicator of operational performance and revenue growth.

kpis.name: Average Ship Count
kpis.explanation: Average number of cruise ships on which OneSpaWorld operates health and wellness centers during the period.
kpis.description: This KPI measures the expansion of the partner ship portfolio and serves as an indicator of potential future growth.
kpis.signal: Key metric impacting revenue and profitability, reflecting the expansion of operational capacity.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue remaining after deducting cost of goods sold.
kpis.description: Gross margin measures the company's efficiency in producing or acquiring the goods and services it sells.
kpis.signal: Key indicator of profitability in core operations.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue remaining after deducting operating expenses.
kpis.description: Operating margin indicates a company's performance in its core business activities.
kpis.signal: Measures profitability of core operations before interest and taxes.

kpis.name: R&D Investments as a Percentage of Revenue
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue allocated to research and development.
kpis.description: R&D expenditures reflect OneSpaWorld's investment in emerging technologies to enhance its offerings and operations.
kpis.signal: Indicates the company's commitment to innovation and development of new technologies, particularly in generative and agentic AI applications.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Spending on fixed assets for the maintenance and expansion of operations.
kpis.description: CAPEX supports the expansion and maintenance of the global infrastructure required for OneSpaWorld's operations.
kpis.signal: Reflects investments in operational capacity and future growth.

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees in the company.
kpis.description: Headcount is a key indicator of operational capacity and labor costs for a service-based company.
kpis.signal: Indicator of organizational size and growth potential.

kpis.short: Intégration de l'IA dans les opérations
kpis.name: Integration of Generative and Agentic AI
kpis.explanation: Degree of integration of generative and agentic AI technologies into OneSpaWorld's recruitment, training, and logistics platforms.
kpis.description: OneSpaWorld is actively developing AI-powered recruitment, training, and logistics platforms, creating a sustainable competitive advantage in managing its operational complexity.
kpis.signal: Reflects OneSpaWorld's strategic commitment to adopting emerging technologies to improve operational efficiency and service quality.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions.
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + buybacks (2021-2025) in billions USD. Source yfinance cashflow.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du résultat net redistribuée. >80 % = potentiellement non soutenable.

ai_positioning.summary: OneSpaWorld is actively integrating generative and agentic artificial intelligence technologies into its global recruitment, training, and logistics platforms to enhance operational efficiency, maintain quality standards, and maximize revenue per health and wellness center.
evidence: developed powerful recruiting, training and logistics platforms, increasingly powered by emerging technologies, including generative and agentic artificial intelligence applications, to manage our operational complexity, maintain our industry-leading quality standards, and maximize revenue and profitability per health and wellness center
